name: Shinseki no Oba-san ~Hanare no Netsujo, Honke no Gosai~
original_name: 親戚の小母さん～離れの熟女、本家の後妻～
source:
Main character returns to his home village. At night he goes to the sound of water in the woods behind the house and sees his mother masturbating in the basin. She accepts son's desire, and their secret meetings start to happen at various places in the village.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
